text: {"claims":[{"quote":"Consistent with our Project Spring roadmap, we continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business.","promised":"maintain margin guidance of 11% to 13% for Wires & Cables","metric":"margin","horizon":"medium- to long-term"},{"quote":"where we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.","promised":"target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030 for FMEG","metric":"margin","horizon":"FY 2030"},{"quote":"we expect the working capital cycle to settle within our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.","promised":"working capital cycle to settle within 45 to 50 days","metric":"working capital cycle","horizon":"long-term"},{"quote":"Capital expenditure during the quarter amounted to INR 3.2 billion, reflecting our continued commitment to building capacity and strengthening future growth drivers.","promised":"capital expenditure of INR 3.2 billion for the quarter","metric":"capex","horizon":"quarter"},{"quote":"Over the medium to long term, we continue to expect sustainable operating margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range.","promised":"sustainable operating margins in the high single-digit range for EPC","metric":"margin","horizon":"medium to long term"},{"quote":"Our strategic priorities remain unchanged to grow at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth while progressively enhancing profitability.","promised":"grow at 1.5x to 2x of industry growth","metric":"growth","horizon":"future"}]}
